notes.title: Update 11/06/15
notes.content:
v1.21 released!

Main changes:
-Changed disposition of Single-Player modes
-Added Custom masks scale option in Video settings (default is x1.5)
-Partial Xbox360 Joystick Support (Menù and settings work only with mouse)
-Now maps clean up correctly when leaving a tournament

notes.title: Update 08/06/15
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who help me test Overgravity MP.

Fixed some errors in MP mode.
Prevent character being cloned during the match.
Fixed chat controls (now it opens with T, F2 and close with Enter, Back, F2).
Fixed minor bugs.

Controller support is coming next Update.
Stay Tuned!
